title: Research: shorten R420 cleanup by two XORs with certified conjugation (no new kappa)
head: d97c8d20a8b885271a24c5a4e8446ac7f5697d5c
body:
This finite bit-circuit construction shortens PR543's R420 cleanup from **2,973 to 2,971 binary XORs**, with complete local ADDs **26,916 to 26,914**. Two repeated XOR sandwiches share one blocker; exact F2 conjugation replaces five gates by three. **Status: research construction / finite circuit improvement; no new kappa.**

The forward D/A/scatter/B word stays fixed. All 660 symbolic input columns, arbitrary helper restoration, per-register frame paths, 420 helpers, nine copies and rank mass 5,112 are preserved. The forward positive-prefix bound stays 144,651; reverse decreases 2,270,064 to 2,266,968. All four deleted and two added reads are charged.

The interface change is explicit: the original literal-reversal H4 rejects this representation. The package proves and checks H4-prime, legal full-frame cleanup implementing the same inverse U. No predecessor checker is patched. The identity is over F2, and positive integer envelopes are checked separately.

```sh
python3 -B research/r420-cleanup-commutation/verify.py
```

Expected final line: `PASS_R420_CLEANUP_CONJUGATION C=2973->2971 native_adds=26916->26914 columns=660 kappa=unchanged`.

Exact base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. PR543 dependency: `2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535`; both input Git blobs match that head. Only `research/r420-cleanup-commutation/` is added. The package contains a complete recipe, exact certificate, written proof, reproducible verifier, attribution and validation receipt.

Validation passed on macOS / Python 3.14.8 with standard-library Python only:

- All 672 frames, all 660 symbolic dirty-input columns, inverse map and unchanged paid paths.
- Complete 18-pair duplicate census. Every duplicate pair has a blocker, proving no cancellation is possible using commuting swaps and pair deletion alone on this fixed cleanup. Both one-blocker pairs are used; no general circuit optimality is claimed.
- Six negative controls and the full 16-input local truth table.
- Optimized-Python execution, minimal relocated archive replay and selected-record binding.
- Independent Codex-worker replay without repository checking/optimizer imports.
- Existing native exporter on both words, with binary counts, per-register MOVE paths, COPY/ERASE, frame/state data and positive prefixes compared. Native records decrease 29,874 to 29,872.

OS assignment seed **10**, bit-supplier track. No pinned sprint issue exists, so the claim is local. The final metadata refresh through #709 distinguishes this cleanup-only conjugation from #670/#674/#688 phase-B synthesis, #691 phase-A synthesis, #686/#694 frame-zero sharing, and #708 decoder-total sharing. #708 changes the forward totals and raises measured prefix bounds; this result keeps forward gates fixed and lowers the reverse bound. No pending patch is imported or composed.

The C++ cohort replay was not run because Boost headers were unavailable. Recursive hosted-parent reconstruction, renamed-instruction/residual-host audits, full invoice and changed-word outer assembly remain integration work. Repository-wide `make verify`, unchanged selected cold replay, Lean and remote CI were not run or claimed. All inherited compiler/common-label/mutable-basis/hosting/signed-lift/precision/tape/analytic obligations remain. The selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Credit remains with eumemic's PR543/493, Dylan Crow, Zhihao Chen, the #472 realization and the cumulative lineage identified in the README. Prepared for **Sagar Thakrar (@thakrarsagar)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including a separate audit worker, under Apache-2.0. No independent human review claimed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
